test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.**

I received good concesions while purchasing a mobile phone.
solution: The correct answer is **"concessions."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correctly spelt word is **'concessions.'** • **"Concessions"** means something that you agree to do in order to end an argument. (एक अधिकार या लाभ जो लोगों के एक समूह, एक संगठन आदि को दिया जाए; छूट) • **Example**: *Employers have been forced to make **concessions**__ to the union.* • The correct answer is** Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - 'recieved'** is misspelled. The correct spelling is **'received.' ** • It means to get or accept something that somebody sends or gives to you. (प्राप्‍त या स्‍वीकार करना (दूसरे के द्वारा भेजी या दी गई वस्‍तु को)) • **Option 2 - 'whaile' **is misspelled. The correct spelling is** 'while.'** • It means during the time that; when. (उस समय जब; जब) • **Option 4 - 'paurchasing'** is misspelled. The correct spelling is** 'purchasing.'** • It means acquire (something) by paying for it; buy. (ख़रीदना, क्रय करना) 3e:Tc06, The correct answer is **"out and out."**
